attention_path.observer_effect: Tensor hooks and passive call adapters must not change modes, tensors or math. Training already excludes inference fastpaths; never switch to eval/no_grad or disable an otherwise-used path just to collect data. Prefer no module hooks; if used, prove no additional branch change under the same frozen training conditions.
